extracted.name: Simple Beef Stew
extracted.description: You can feel good about serving your family this simple and hearty beef stew that's full of tender beef and lots of vegetables, all combined in a thick gravy-like sauce.
ingredient_lines: 2 pounds room temperature beef stew meat, cut into 1 1/2-inch cubes
3 yellow potatoes, or more to taste, cubed
1 teaspoon Creole seasoning (such as Tony Chachere's®)
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat. Add meat, flour, onion, and garlic; cook and stir until browned, 10 to 15 minutes.

Add broth, tomatoes, potatoes, celery, and carrots, then stir in Creole seasoning and basil. Bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to maintain simmer and cook, uncovered, until potatoes are soft, meat is tender, and gravy is thick, about 1 hour.
